entries.label: session系全試験の機械列挙実行（決定的射影）
argv:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
files = sorted(
    str(path)
    for pattern in (
        'test_session_log*.py',
        'test_session_artifact*.py',
        'test_redaction*.py',
        'test_session_bootstrap_e2e.py',
    )
    for path in Path('tests').glob(pattern)
)
print('files', len(files))
result = subprocess.run(
    ['.venv/bin/python3', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', *files],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)
print('exit', result.returncode)
print(result.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1].rsplit(' in ', 1)[0])
